transcript: Join me at the theater tonight I'm seeing Tick…Tick…Boom! at the Cape Playhouse in Cape Cod with my entire family I'm the oldest of eight kids and every year my parents plan a family vacation. Last summer we were in the Berkshires and I made the entire family go see Cabaret at Barrington Stage and this year we got super lucky because Cape Playhouse's production of Tick…Tick…Boom! happened to overlap. Funny enough I actually saw this production at Bucks County Playhouse last year and Andy Mientus and Krystina Alabado actually reprised their roles but Noah Ricketts is in The Great Gastby so instead we had Larry Owens who I love I've never been to the Cape Playhouse before but it is an absolutely beautiful theater And we learned an awesome story Jonathan Larson's sister Julie Larson reached out to me She told me this which is very moving that Jonathan Larson saw his first play in this room it was 1963 or 1964 he was three years old It was the Wizard of Oz he spent his whole summer pretending to be the Tin Man. This story absolutely destroyed me I love Jonathan Larson and Tick…Tick… Boom! has some of my favorite Jonathan songs Come To Your Senses Louder Than Words Therapy This production is just it's really special it's funny and emotional and the three of them have great chemistry and I think the family really liked it. I made everyone watch the movie on Thanksgiving a few years ago so they were familiar with the story but they all had a lot of questions about Jonathan and his legacy I would love to come back to the Playhouse later in the summer because they're doing Waitress! what luck that this was here during our vacation!
